items.title: Germany news: Chancellor Merz says he wouldn't advise his kids to go to the US
items.description: Chancellor Friedrich Merz said he wouldn't currently advise young Germans like his children to move to the US to study or work. He cited "the social climate that has suddenly developed."

items.title: Is it safe to swim at England's bathing sites?

items.title: India news: PM Modi visits the Netherlands at start of Europe tour
items.description: Modi is looking to deepen India's trade agreements with its European partners and diversify beyond China-centric supply chains. Meanwhile, Indian farmers are once again clashing with the police. Follow DW.

items.title: Ukraine: Dozens of European countries sign up to special tribunal plan to prosecute Russia
items.description: At talks in Moldova, more than 30 countries have said they will join a future special tribunal for Ukraine prosecuting Russia over its invasion. How the body will force Russians to stand trial is not clear.
